entities.name: Transaction identifier
entities.description: An information element used in network procedures when supporting mobility between S1 mode and A/Gb or Iu modes.

entities.name: UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
entities.description: Condition that the UE supports A/Gb mode, Iu mode, or both modes.

entities.name: Network supports mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb or Iu mode
entities.description: Condition that the network supports mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode, Iu mode, or both.

relations.description: The network shall include the Transaction identifier IE if it supports mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb or Iu mode.
The network condition for including the Transaction identifier IE applies when the UE supports A/Gb mode, Iu mode, or both.
